text:
sam_fin: Heads-up : NordCrest (reseller_id NC-118) disputed an Azure Marketplace refund applied to their annual commitment when they cancelled 5 seats mid-term. Azure issued a prorated refund, but the refund was applied in USD while our contract and the original charge were in EUR, causing a €1,120 FX difference on our invoice.

olive_ops: pulling the invoice lines now. attached snippet from export:
```
invoice_id,sku,description,units,unit_price,total,currency
INV-AZ-2026-09,AZ-SUBS-RESELLER-11,Subscription seats (annual) - refund,5,0.00,-1500.00,USD
```

marta_sales: NordCrest signed in EUR and their partner pricing (band D) expects EUR settlement. If Azure posts the refund in USD we bear FX risk per our marketplace contract unless manifest shows customer-initiated refund.

revops: tagging REV-5301. we need: 1) Azure refund manifest, 2) FX rate used on Azure invoice, 3) whether refund was initiated by NordCrest or by marketplace. opening case with Azure.

az-billing-bot: Support ticket CASE-AZ-224466 created. Azure ETA 4 business days.

sam_fin: ok don't do any partner chargebacks yet. If Azure confirms they issued refund in wrong currency we request corrected invoice (EUR) or FX reimbursement. If Azure refuses, we may have to negotiate with NordCrest on split of FX delta and document for revenue recognition.

olive_ops: I'll also flag invoicing pipeline to capture currency on refunds so we can auto-detect these next time. OPS-7721 created.

marta_sales: i'll prep a neutral partner note in case we need to explain timing to NordCrest. keep it factual.

sam_fin: thanks team. keeping this thread as canonical audit trail for REV-5301. will update when CASE-AZ-224466 responds.
